name: browser-use
headline: programmatic video creation with claude
short_description: Create videos programmatically with Claude Code and Remotion. This starter kit provides pre-built components, AI integrations, and a streamlined workflow for generating professional videos. Ideal for operations teams looking to automate video content creation.
author: jhartquist

sections.overview:
Claude Remotion Kickstart is a starter kit for generating videos programmatically with Claude Code and Remotion. It includes pre-built slide and overlay components, AI-powered asset generation (images, videos, voiceovers via Replicate, Deepgram, and ElevenLabs), configurable rendering presets, and transcript-based timing to sync visuals with voiceovers. The kit provides slash commands for creating new compositions, generating assets, and transcribing audio. It's designed for operations teams and developers who want to automate video content creation with familiar tools like Tailwind CSS for styling and Node.js for scripting.
Automate tutorial and documentation video generation
Create demo videos with code snippets and syntax highlighting
Generate video content with AI-powered voiceovers and captions
Build batch video rendering pipelines with GitHub Actions
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/jhartquist/claude-remotion-kickstart`
sections.usage:
```
Generate a professional video using the claude-remotion-kickstart starter kit with the following specifications: [VIDEO_TOPIC]. Use [TONE] and [STYLE]. Include [BRAND_NAME] branding with [COLOR_SCHEME]. Add [BACKGROUND_MUSIC] and [VOICEOVER_STYLE]. The video should be [DURATION] long and target [AUDIENCE].
```
Copy

```
Here’s a 60-second promotional video for **TechFlow Solutions**, a SaaS company specializing in AI-driven workflow automation. The video follows a modern, sleek corporate style with a blue-and-white color scheme and a professional voiceover in a calm, authoritative tone.

**Opening Scene (0:00-0:10):**
A clean, minimalist title slide appears with the TechFlow Solutions logo and the tagline *"Automate Smarter, Work Faster."* The background is a gradient of soft blues, and the voiceover begins: *"In today’s fast-paced business world, efficiency isn’t just a goal—it’s a necessity."*

**Scene 1 (0:10-0:25):**
A split-screen animation shows a chaotic office environment on the left (with stacks of paperwork, slow software interfaces, and frustrated employees) and a streamlined, automated workflow on the right (with smooth data flows, integrated tools, and happy teams). The voiceover continues: *"But manual processes and disconnected tools slow you down. What if you could automate the repetitive tasks that drain your team’s time?"*

**Scene 2 (0:25-0:40):**
A dashboard animation highlights TechFlow’s AI-driven automation platform. Key features like *automated data entry, workflow orchestration, and real-time analytics* are visually demonstrated with smooth transitions. The voiceover explains: *"TechFlow Solutions uses AI to automate your workflows—from data entry to complex processes—so your team can focus on what matters most."*

**Scene 3 (0:40-0:50):**
A testimonial-style clip features a fictional customer, *Sarah Chen, COO of GreenLogistics*, saying: *"Since implementing TechFlow, we’ve reduced our order processing time by 70%. Our team is more productive, and our customers are happier."* The screen shows a before-and-after comparison of their workflow efficiency.

**Closing Scene (0:50-1:00):**
The TechFlow Solutions logo reappears with a call-to-action: *"Ready to automate smarter? Visit techflow.ai to book a demo today."* The background music fades out as the logo animates dynamically. The video ends with a subtle fade to black.

**Technical Details:**
- Format: 1080p MP4
- Background Music: Light electronic track with a corporate feel
- Voiceover: AI-generated, neutral American accent
- Branding: Consistent use of TechFlow’s blue (#2A5CAA) and white color scheme
- Duration: 60 seconds

This video is ready for use in marketing campaigns, social media, or internal training materials. The claude-remotion-kickstart starter kit was used to generate all scenes, transitions, and animations programmatically, ensuring consistency and scalability for future video projects.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
